# Arrive Every Day

- Sit down. Relax.
- Look at the quote.
- Phones are okay until attendance is finished.
- No talking during attendance.

# Why do this?

::: {.big-prompt}
Why do you think we start class this way?
:::

# Attendance

::: {.big-prompt}
**Physically present:** required.
:::

When called, say **"here"** loudly enough for me to hear.

**If I do not hear you and see you, I cannot mark you present.**

# Participation

- Participation includes **in class** and **online**.
- Lateness, extended time out of class, and avoiding participation count.
- Preventing someone else from learning also counts.

::: {.big-prompt}
**Participation is a significant part of the grade.**
:::

# Essential Expectations

- Respect the **timers and transitions**.
- Respect **no-phone** moments.
- Respect **no-talking** moments.
- Let other people learn.

::: {.big-prompt}
Otherwise, I am very flexible. This class should be a lot of fun.
:::

# Very Difficult to Fail

::: {.big-prompt}
Submit your work and it is very difficult to fail my class.
:::

The main way to fail is to submit **little or nothing**.

More importantly: **do not prevent other people from learning.**

# Any Questions?

::: {.big-prompt}
Ask now. Ask later. Ask when you need help.
:::

If you think something can be better, **speak up**.  
We want to **grow together**.

# Announcements {.announcements-slide}

- Welcome to the course!

# Today's Route

- **10-15 min:** Name game
- **5-10 min:** Build a name tag
- Document the work
- Submit **one PDF with your student number**
- **Final 15 min:** reflection + reset

# Entering Flow: Name Game

**10-15 minutes**

1. Say your **preferred name**.
2. Add one simple **action or gesture**.
3. Repeat a few names/actions before adding your own.
4. Help each other.

# Name Tag V1

::: {.big-prompt}
Make a clear, useful name tag that helps me learn your name.
:::

**5-10 minutes**

# How I Am Marking It

- **Photo quality** · /2
- **Crop + layout** · /2
- **Student number** · /2
- **PDF skill** · /2
- **Following instructions** · /2

::: {.big-prompt}
**/10** · Communication and process, not artistic talent.

# One PDF

::: {.big-prompt}
**One finished PDF. Your student number on the page.**
:::

# Why So Specific?

::: {.big-prompt}
**In engineering and consulting, the deliverable has to work for the person receiving it. It must be professional and confidential.**
:::

# Why PDF?

- PDFs are **stable snapshots** of finished work.
- They open consistently across devices and software.
- Editable files are working files and have hidden details. A PDF is the **deliverable**.
- Clear presentation makes good work easier to understand and trust.

# Example PDF

::: {.big-prompt}
One page. Clear photo. Student number.
:::

<iframe src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrandrewandrade/slides/master/assets/examples/name-tag-example.pdf.pdf#view=FitH" title="Example name tag PDF" style="width:100%; height:58vh; border:0;"></iframe>

# Document + Submit

1. Take a **clear, well-lit photo**.
2. Put it on one page and crop it cleanly.
3. Add **Submitted by: your-student-number**.
4. Export as **PDF**.
5. **Open the PDF and check it.**
6. Submit it to **Google Classroom**.

# Mission Complete

- Name tag is easy to read.
- Photo is clear and well composed.
- Student number uses the required format.
- PDF opens and looks correct.
- Correct PDF is submitted.
- Physical name tag goes home and comes back usable.
